name: Agile Robots Agile ONE S
summary: A compact 1.4 m bipedal research humanoid from Munich with an open software stack, Jetson Thor compute and a swappable battery; hands or grippers are optional extras.

germany.statusNote: MegaRobotics (Kaarst), which calls itself an official Agile Robots distributor, lists Agile ONE S as a new product with price and availability on request. Agile Robots (Munich) plans to start production of ONE S and ONE SN by the end of 2026.

sellers.name: MegaRobotics (MEGAFORCE GmbH, Kaarst)
sellers.note: "Beschaffung auf Anfrage" / "Preis & Verfügbarkeit anfragen"; calls itself an official Agile Robots distributor (not verified with the maker).

specs.label: Degrees of freedom (without hands)
specs.conditions: legs 2 x 6, waist 3, arms 2 x 7, neck 2

specs.label: Payload per arm
specs.conditions: up to 3 kg at the bare flange, without hand or gripper
specs.quote: up to 3 kg (bare flange, without hand or gripper)

specs.label: Onboard compute
specs.value: NVIDIA Jetson Thor T5000 + Intel Core i3 N305
specs.quote: NVIDIA Jetson Thor T5000 + Intel Core i3 N305

specs.label: Battery
specs.quote: Li-ion, 9 Ah / 421.2 Wh, 46.8 V nominal, quick-swappable

specs.label: End effectors
specs.value: standard non-functional hand model; optional 1-DOF two-finger gripper or four-finger dexterous hand
specs.conditions: dexterous hand DOF differs: 13 (MegaRobotics) vs 9 (maker page)
specs.quote: Standard: non-functional hand model. Optional: two-finger gripper (1 DoF) or four-finger dexterous hand (13 DoF), both from Agile Robots

specs.label: Simulation assets
specs.quote: URDF and USD assets are provided

specs.label: Production start
specs.conditions: company plan, reported by Reuters via TechNode
specs.quote: Production of the Agile ONE S and ONE SN models is scheduled to begin by the end of 2026

capabilities.sdk: Open software stack (bring your own models); URDF and USD assets
notes: Ships with non-functional hand models; a two-finger gripper or a four-finger dexterous hand are options.
Research and teaching platform; the maker says skills developed on it can move to the full-size Agile ONE.
Differs from Agile ONE SN, which ships with tactile five-finger hands and preinstalled NVIDIA Isaac GR00T.

evidence.task: Embodied-AI research, imitation learning and university teaching
evidence.note: Lab platform; no site or factory use reported.
